note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Steps of browser/app screens are done by hand by the person recording.
prepare: $have = Invoke-Command -Session $s { sqlcmd -S localhost -E -h -1 -W -Q "SET NOCOUNT ON; SELECT COALESCE(DB_ID('ContosoBikesDW'),0)" }

if ([int]($have | Select-Object -First 1) -eq 0) { Invoke-Command -Session $s { sqlcmd -S localhost -E -b -i C:\lab\ep11\01-create-database.sql; sqlcmd -S localhost -E -b -i C:\lab\ep11\02-load-data.sql; sqlcmd -S localhost -E -b -i C:\lab\ep11\03-agg-view.sql } }
Connect-PowerBIServiceAccount   # owner signs in as labadmin (Part B only)

screens.name: model-view
steps: Open C:\MGLab\power-bi\ep11\src\ContosoSalesComposite.pbip (preview feature Power BI Project save option on); sign in to 10.50.0.30 with the lab SQL login (db_owner on ContosoBikesDW)
Model view, properties pane: Sales = DirectQuery, Sales Agg = Import and hidden, Date, Product, Customer, Store = Dual; relationships solid lines
Select Sales Agg > Manage aggregations: mapping of the five columns
mask: account name and picture at the top right of Power BI Desktop (sign out first)
Windows user name in any file path (record from C:\MGLab)

screens.name: sql-observe
steps: SSMS connected to 10.50.0.30 (lab SQL login or CONTOSO sysadmin): run sql\07-clear-plan-cache.sql
Desktop DAX query view: run queries\01-hit-sales-by-year-category.dax
SSMS: run sql\06-observe-directquery.sql: record whether the hit leaves no row
Desktop: run queries\02-miss-sales-by-customer-country.dax; SSMS: run 06 again: one statement over FactSales and DimCustomer
mask: Windows user name in SSMS recent files
SQL login name if it shows

screens.name: budget-composite
steps: Open a report on the published ContosoSales model (live connection) > Make changes to this model
Add data from C:\MGLab\power-bi\ep11\src\data\budget\budget.csv as Import; relate Budget to Store (store name) and Date; show the relationships drawn as limited
Matrix by store for 2025 with Sales Amount, Budget Amount and the measure from queries\06-sales-vs-budget.dax
mask: tenant domain, browser URL ids, account picture and name

teardown: Invoke-Command -Session $s { sqlcmd -S localhost -E -Q "IF DB_ID('ContosoBikesDW') IS NOT NULL BEGIN ALTER DATABASE ContosoBikesDW SET SINGLE_USER WITH ROLLBACK IMMEDIATE; DROP DATABASE ContosoBikesDW END"; Remove-Item C:\lab\ep11 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
owner_notes: Owner: create the SQL login with db_owner on ContosoBikesDW and run sql\04-scale-up.sql (adds 499 copies of the lines) before the observe screen if the big table is wanted; password is typed in Desktop's credential dialog only. Episode 14 reuses ContosoBikesDW: do not tear down if 14 is recorded next. Part B needs ContosoSales published from episode 1.
